title: Unified same-family ledger and complete additive-seven predicates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Trim_N=the UNCHANGED family.evaluate on ALL N bits: exact alpha=1/(1-beta), logarithmically trimmed SU capacity, inverse-capacity responses, public plateau/tail variable gaps. Its first-tie controller still minimizes the COARSE source_certificate u(p). The sharper v_N is analysis only and does not alter selected plans. Uniform P/empty-witness NP verifier; fallback0,v_N=u_N=N+1.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For the SAME unchanged coarse-controller selected plan, use ST targets I_u>=O and leaf capacity c. Set sharp(p)=c+1+sum[(T_u-1)*(I_u-1)],v_N=min(d_plan,sharp(p)); fallback v_N=u_N=N+1. For EVERY integer N>=0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-8v_N+7>=4N-8u_N+7. Nonfallback v_N>=3 permits the fully supplied additive7 gate theorem; the complete RamseyR RUP and read-onceQ predicates are validated by the declared audit. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, v_N<=u_N<=2^ceil(D_trim Z), D_trim=139829/50000=2.79658,Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Thus for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(Trim_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths and this SAME fixed eligible family has liminf C_B2(Trim_N)/N>=4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
